array.string: echo 'SBLOG start' >/dev/console; sleep 130; /usr/bin/log show --last 4m --style compact --predicate '(process == "NotificationCenter" OR process == "containermanagerd" OR process == "chronod") AND (messageType == error OR messageType == fault OR eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "container" OR eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "group")' 2>&1 | /usr/bin/head -120 >/dev/console; echo 'SBLOG nc done' >/dev/console; /usr/bin/log show --last 5m --style compact --predicate '(process == "WallpaperAgent" OR process == "WallpaperVideoExtension" OR process == "WallpaperImageExtension") AND (messageType == error OR messageType == fault OR eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "image" OR eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "choice" OR eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "fail")' 2>&1 | /usr/bin/head -120 >/dev/console; echo 'SBLOG done' >/dev/console
